name: Eligible discharge offer documented
definition: Eligible discharges with an offer state
missingness_rule: missing offer state remains missing and counts against completeness

name: Preference and acceptance documented
definition: Offered discharges with preference and acceptance state
missingness_rule: missing preference or acceptance is not refusal

name: Appointment state resolved
definition: Accepted offers with a resolved appointment state
numerator: accepted offers with scheduled unavailable declined or exception state

name: Thirty-day acute return
definition: Eligible discharges with an acute return within 30 days
action: refer for safety and methods review

name: Discharge delay
definition: Eligible discharges with workflow-attributed delay beyond local threshold

name: Scheduling workload
definition: Median staff minutes per accepted offer

name: Offer reach by prespecified group
definition: Eligible discharges with offer state by group
source: prospective workflow and source-recorded group fields
subgroup_rule: no merging and suppress unsupported rates

name: Completion by prespecified group
definition: Accepted offers with completed follow-up by group
subgroup_rule: no merging and suppress unsupported rates

name: Workflow fidelity
definition: Observed cases completing all required workflow states

name: Offer and preference completeness
definition: Eligible discharges with complete offer and preference fields
numerator: eligible discharges with both fields complete
subgroup_rule: show missingness by group when supported

name: Appointment and completion completeness
definition: Accepted offers with resolved appointment and completion states
numerator: accepted offers with both states resolved
action: pause outcome interpretation and correct linkage
subgroup_rule: show missingness by group when supported
